$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: What the bow is for, and where its numbers come from.

fullDrawTicks.description: Sim ticks (60 Hz) of holding fire to reach full draw (48 = 800 ms).

minDrawTicks.description: A release before this many ticks of draw cancels the shot and returns the arrow; ≤ fullDrawTicks.

maxLaunchSpeed.description: Launch speed at full draw, m/s.

minLaunchFraction.description: Fraction of maxLaunchSpeed at zero draw, 0–1; the speed lerps linearly to 1 at full draw.

drawStaminaCost.description: Stamina spent when a draw starts (never refunded).

holdTicks.description: Ticks full draw may be held for free; past them stamina drains and at 0 the draw collapses.

holdDrainPerSecond.description: Stamina drained per second while full draw is held past holdTicks.

walkScale.description: Movement speed while drawn, as a fraction of the run speed (0–1); no sprint.

fov.description: Camera vertical field of view at full draw, degrees (the camera’s is 70).

time.description: Seconds for the field of view to ease about two thirds of the way in (and back out).

aim.description: Presentation: the over-shoulder aim view while drawn (src/game/camera).
